chapter_title: Framework Comparison and When to Pick Which
course_outline_concepts: Feature matrix across verl / OpenRLHF / TRL: rollout mode, parallelism, algos supported
Entropy / KL / loss logging patterns -- what each ships by default
Performance characteristics: GPU util, throughput, straggler handling
Community + maintenance velocity -- where each repo is in 2026
Decision tree: which framework for which run (single-node experiment vs 128-GPU production)

sources.what_to_extract: Inline PPO loop with value head; symmetric clip only; K1 and K2 KL estimators; KL as non_score_reward; PPO now experimental (trl/experimental/ppo/); default stack pivoted to GRPO/RLOO.

Monolithic _compute_loss with loss_type switches (grpo, dr_grpo, dapo, cispo, sapo, luspo, vespo, bnpo); top_entropy_quantile masking; K3 KL in loss; sequence-level GSPO importance sampling; vllm_importance_sampling_correction; Dr.GRPO aggregation fix.
Two samples per prompt per step; judge/reward function pluggable; sigmoid + ipo loss types; sibling files for nash_md, xpo, self_distillation; online DPO is TRL-exclusive.

PolicyLoss nn.Module with asymmetric clip_eps_low/high, dual_clip, GSPO, three vLLM IS correction modes (tis, seq-mask-tis, icepop); AdaptiveKLController; KL applied to reward (token-level) not loss; Ray-distributed actor/critic.
Offline DPO; concatenated_forward to halve activation memory; MoE aux loss + label_smoothing + ipo + NLL mix; reference model held in eval; no online DPO variant.

@register_policy_loss('vanilla') with asymmetric clip_ratio_low/high, dual-clip (clip_ratio_c=3.0), rollout_is_weights, agg_loss registry; K1/K2/K3 KL switches in kl_penalty; registry pattern decouples algorithm from trainer.

compute_grpo_outcome_advantage: group-relative z-score, norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo toggle (Dr.GRPO mode), singleton group zero-advantage, returns=advantages (no critic), registry-pluggable adv estimator, Pass@k variant.

HFRollout (debug) + vllm_async_server (production); tokens-in-tokens-out; per-request priority for partial rollout; pause-state during weight broadcast; LoRA-as-adapter; SPMD sync mode retired (PR #4411).

Three KL estimators K1/K2/K3; where each framework applies KL (reward shaping vs loss term); OpenRLHF vllm_kl diagnostic; two 'entropy' fields in TRL PPO (biased vs true H); cross-framework entropy/KL comparison table.
Convergent community defaults (T=1.0, top_p=1.0, c_H=0.0, beta 0.01-0.1, G=8-32); adv-normalization OFF by default in TRL (footgun); GRPO group_size conventions; triage order when entropy collapses.

OpenRLHF async (Hu 2024 arXiv:2405.11143): Ray rollout_queue/rollout_slots/vllm_lock; verl HybridFlow (arXiv:2409.19256): async vLLM with priority + pause state; 1.6x-2.0x throughput vs sync; staleness bounded at k=queue_depth+partial_rollout_depth; IS correction mandatory.

deliverables: read.md (220-280 lines, content format with 15+-row feature matrix, decision-tree flowchart, graduation criteria)
figures/framework-compare.html (interactive toggle: user requirements -> recommended framework + why, ~200-280 lines)
hard_rules: No external CDN references in HTML (inline CSS/JS only)
Feature matrix must be dense with attested facts -- every cell traces to a raw-data source file and line range
Every framework claim cites real import paths and line ranges from the source files
Decision tree must be reproducible text (not an image) so the wiki-linter can validate wikilinks
Synthesis chapter: does not invent new facts -- only composes attested facts across the three sub-framework chapters (ch-55 verl, ch-56 OpenRLHF, ch-57 TRL)
